way: Start from the exit: the object the camera stares at for the last five seconds, too small or too thin to hold another world, and design the world backwards from it.
law of space to break: two places share one floor, one of them upside down
scale: the size of one giant sleeping animal
kind of light: the last light before a curtain rises

way: Start from the camera's motion on its stretch of rail and ask what kind of place would make that motion inevitable.
law of space to break: gravity points at whatever is nearest

way: Start from the inhabitant: decide who lives there and how it moves, then build the place it needs.
law of space to break: a thing and its reflection have swapped places
scale: the size of a single room that takes hours to cross
way the inhabitants move: they are carried by something else

way: Start from the law of space in your kit and make everything else serve it.
law of space to break: distance is measured in sound, so quiet things are far
kind of light: the light inside a closed eyelid
